input: Find circus, aerial, film, animation and photography camps for kids for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville aerial circus summer camp 2026 kids

candidates.name: Empyrean Arts
candidates.note: 2026 kids circus camp for ages 6–11 included aerial hoop, sling, silks and trapeze.

candidates.name: The Performing Arts Company of Asheville
candidates.note: Summer circus-and-stage camps for ages 4–7 and 8–16 combine aerial silks, juggling, tumbling and musical theater.

candidates.name: Lisa Smith Teaches
candidates.note: 2026 movie-making camps for ages 6–14 cover scripting, storyboarding, acting, directing and editing in East Asheville.

candidates.name: Asheville Art Museum
candidates.note: 2026 art camps included camera-free photography using light, chemistry and image transfers for rising grades 9–12.

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 residential Film Scoring & Sound Design program served rising high school sophomores through seniors.
